paragraphs: In Rosh Hashanah 4a and Megillah 13b he reports Rav. Hyman reports that Yuchasin cites R' Abba bar Lima.[^1]

notes.text: The two whole Davidson Rosh Hashanah 4a and Megillah 13b paragraphs have Rabbah bar Lima reporting Rav. The distinct Yuchasin form remains Hyman’s uncollated report; its abbreviated personal title is rendered R'. No Abba/Rabbah identity is admitted.
